title: A Universal Plasticizer Alkylsulfonic Phenyl Ester Activates Pregnane X Receptor to Increase Intestinal Cholesterol Uptake.
authors: Okore, Nnamdi; Kariuki, Wangeci; Brown, Conner; Moxley, Michael A; Ramirez, Naara; Sui, Yipeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究增塑剂ASE激活核受体PXR影响胆固醇摄取，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alkylsulfonic phenyl ester (ASE) is an alternate non-phthalate plasticizer used in PVC and polyurethane manufacture, such as for medical tubing and toys. Plastic-associated endocrine disrupting chemicals have been associated with increased cardiovascular disease risks and have been established as the agonists of a xenobiotic sensor, pregnane X receptor (PXR), which has atherogenic and dyslipidemic effects. However, it is unknown whether ASE activates PXR to adversely affect cardiovascular system. Our objective is to investigate how ASE impacts lipid profiles and cholesterol uptake via PXR signaling. Human hepatic and intestinal cells were used to test activation of PXR by ASE. The computational docking study and site-directed mutagenesis were used to identify key amino acid residues in PXR that interacted with ASE. The natural PXR inhibitor resveratrol was used to prohibit PXR activities. The male C57BL/6 wildtype mice were fed with ASE to evaluate if ASE could alter plasma lipid levels. Our data suggested that ASE was a specific PXR agonist and increased atherogenic cholesterol levels in mice mediated by PXR. Furthermore, ASE treatment increased cholesterol uptake by human intestinal cells through PXR signaling. Our study elucidates the role of PXR as a mediator of xenobiotic-elicited dyslipidemia and provides evidence for the future risk assessment of ASE on cardiovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 烷基磺酸苯酯（ASE）是一种替代邻苯二甲酸酯的非邻苯类增塑剂，用于聚氯乙烯（PVC）和聚氨酯制造，例如医用导管和玩具。与塑料相关的内分泌干扰化学物质已被认为与心血管疾病风险增加有关，并已被确定为外源物感应器孕烷X受体（PXR）的激动剂，该受体具有致动脉粥样硬化和血脂异常效应。然而，尚不清楚ASE是否通过激活PXR对心血管系统产生不利影响。我们的目标是研究ASE如何通过PXR信号传导影响脂质谱和胆固醇摄取。使用人肝细胞和肠细胞测试ASE对PXR的激活作用。采用计算对接研究和定点突变技术来识别PXR中与ASE相互作用的关键氨基酸残基。使用天然PXR抑制剂白藜芦醇来抑制PXR活性。雄性C57BL/6野生型小鼠被喂食ASE，以评估ASE是否能改变血浆脂质水平。我们的数据表明，ASE是一种特异性PXR激动剂，并通过PXR介导增加了小鼠的致动脉粥样硬化胆固醇水平。此外，ASE处理通过PXR信号传导增加了人肠细胞对胆固醇的摄取。我们的研究阐明了PXR作为外源物引发血脂异常介导者的作用，并为未来ASE对心血管疾病风险评估提供了证据。
